budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed four warrants: accounts payable, Middle/High School construction, payroll, and payroll deduction.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $1,096,586.56; a middle/high school construction warrant in the amount of $110,234.99; a payroll warrant in the amount of $768,294.50 and a payroll deduction warrant in the amount of $156,734.15.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lunenburg seeks 5% of Comcast gross annual revenues for operations (up from 2.5%) and $240,000 in capital grants over 10 years (up from $115,000); Comcast responded with 5% and a $130,000 capital grant.
budget_items.quote: lunenburg is seeking 5% of comcast's gross annual revenues as annual operation support for lunenburg's local access programming (up from 2.5% in the current license)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Current operating rate is $2.60 per month per subscriber; if agreed it would rise to $5.20. Alonzo said this is the first increase in ten years.
budget_items.quote: mr. alonzo stated it is currently $2.60 per month per subscriber. if agreed upon, it would go to $5.20 per month per subscriber.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The capital portion would raise the subscriber rate from 29 to .62 per subscriber per month, as printed.
budget_items.quote: that would raise the rate from 29 per subscriber per month to .62 per subscriber per month.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Current permit allows 540,000 gallons per day; new permit review gives Lunenburg an average of 505,000 gallons per day; Lancaster anticipated 250,000 gallons per day, actual around 175,000; district exceeded limit by 7000 gallons per day last year.
budget_items.quote: the new permit review gives lunenburg an average of 505,000 gallons per day, based on historical use from 2010-2015.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lancaster would pay the same rate as Lunenburg residents plus its own overhead costs; the MOU is not yet binding.
budget_items.quote: there is a memorandum of understanding between the water district and lancaster but there is nothing binding at this time.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ebersole noted the town approved a $5 million override for the pavement management plan.
budget_items.quote: the town approved a $5 million override for the pavement management plan

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Current road opening fee is $100 and trench opening fee is $40.00; DPW recommended $50.00 per household per lateral cut and $100 per longitudinal cut, plus owner pays to restore the road. More work needed before finalizing.
budget_items.quote: currently the road opening fee is $100 and the trench opening fee is $40.00.

budget_items.topic: DOER Green Communities technical assistance grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town was awarded a $5,000 DOER technical assistance grant for MRC consulting to prepare the Competitive Green Communities application.
budget_items.quote: the town received notification last week that we were awarded a $5,000 department of energy resources

budget_items.topic: Town Hall mold abatement ductwork cleaning
budget_items.what_was_recorded: An HVAC contractor will clean air ducts; approximate cost $3,000.
budget_items.quote: the approximate cost of that will be $3,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Major renovations at Turkey Hill estimated at $4M; roof replacement identified for FY24 at $1M; MSBA reimbursement (about 50%) would push renovations to FY34.
budget_items.quote: that mr. londa estimates will cost approximately $4m

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Roof replacement identified for FY24 at $1M.
budget_items.quote: is identified for replacement in fy24 for $1m

budget_items.topic: District office space at Turkey Hill (2015 LPS Capital Plan)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The 2015 LPS Capital Plan designated $15,000 to update space at Turkey Hill for district central offices.
budget_items.quote: the 2015 lps capital plan designated $15,000 to update space at turkey hill for district central offices.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: There is a cost to perform the assessment; figures for the firms' proposals are awaited within two weeks. No dollar figure printed.
